description: This PHP class defines an OpenCart admin controller for the 'Product Viewed' report extension. It includes methods for displaying the report configuration page, saving settings, installing/uninstalling the extension, and generating the product viewed report with pagination.

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: Controller class for managing and displaying the 'Product Viewed' report in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the report configuration page, sets up breadcrumbs, and renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the report settings, with permission check, and returns JSON success/error message.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the report extension if the user has modify permissions.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the report extension if the user has modify permissions.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the product viewed report list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report list fragment for Ajax or rendering.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates the HTML view of the product viewed report with pagination and product details.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Placeholder for generating report data; currently only returns success or error JSON.
